title: Speakagain exercise pack
description: A set of words, phrases or sentences to practise in one language. See docs/packs.md.

id.description: Unique id, starting with the language code, such as "en-kitchen-words".

title.description: Short title, in the pack's language.

description.description: One sentence about the pack, in the pack's language.

license.description: Licence for the pack's text and pictures, such as "CC BY-SA 4.0".

exercises.description: name and listen need items with an image; complete needs items with a sentence.

categories.description: Meaning hints by category key, such as {"food": "Something to eat or drink"}.

answer.description: What the person says, written as it is shown.

accept.description: Other answers that also count: plurals, synonyms, regional words, digits.

image.description: "openmoji:<HEX>" for a bundled OpenMoji symbol, or "images/<file>" inside the pack.

category.description: A key of "categories", used as a meaning hint.

cue.description: A meaning hint for this item only.

sentence.description: A sentence or series with ___ where the answer goes, for the complete exercise.
